release: APK 0.2.26 -- the keyboard button brings up the phone keyboard first

Android only. The viewer rail's keyboard button now goes phone keyboard -> PC key panel -> closed
(it opened the PC panel first, with the phone keyboard one tab away), and the panel's tabs put 휴대폰
자판 first. Decided from what is showing, so a phone keyboard the system put away comes back on the
next press. Nothing else on the panel changed (apk-keyboard-phone-first r1, 14ccb41).
Verified: worker's and verifier's independent builds -- assembleDebug + JVM 162/0 (ViewerKeyboardCycle
4 new; a mutation that opens the panel first fails 3 of them). Codex was not on the bus; its review is
requested and pending. Not verified: on a phone (no device attached).

Product: version only (APK versionName 0.2.25 -> 0.2.26, versionCode 24 -> 25; PC stays 0.2.148).
Test: none. Docs: none.
